text_block_list.text:
Held annually at Tracen Academy, the
'Spring Umamusume Traffic Safety Class'
was geared toward elementary school Umamusume.
Sakura Bakushin O and the others were chosen as special lecturers this year, and today I was supporting them—or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, now that we've finished watching the video!
Let's go over the rules one more time~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one!
No walking in the Umamusume-only lane!
Who can tell me whhyyy~?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: (Silence...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh... Ummm...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yes, yes, yes!!
So as not to get in the way of the Umamusume
who are running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
D-Ding-dong-ding-dong! Correct!
If you get tired while running,
make sure to move onto the sidewalk, okay!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's so quiet.
What's wrong? You were all looking forward
to today so much...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's everyone's first time meeting each other!
Of course you'd be nervous!
I'm just a teeensy bit nervous myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In that case, it's time for the Class Rep to take the stage! After all, I'm not nervous in the slightest!!! I shall set an example for everyone! Hahaha!!

And so the lecture continued.
I watched over her quietly, expecting the tension
to melt away with time, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Humans, cars, cats!! Real roads are hectic!!
You're all going to run right through here now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: First of all, bakushin, bakushin through everything!! Now then, who will be our first batter?!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—W-Who's going first?
—I don't wanna go first!
—I'd definitely just mess things up for everyone...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No need to feel anxious!
Let's study hard so you can run on the roads with total peace of mind~!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go by roll call order!
Come on, everyone line up, line up~!

The Umamusume called first timidly steps into the
dedicated Umamusume lane—and right behind her,
another Umamusume can be seen sprinting up at a fierce pace.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Wait! Sto—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Look out!

Right in front of the girl who stopped reflexively, another Umamusume ran past, having slightly slowed down.
She moved like the wind...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Look around before you enter the lane!!
Didn't the nice lady just tell you that?!
What if you had crashed into someone...?!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry...! I-I'm being such a nuisance...!

The Umamusume turns pale, shrinking inward.
An indescribably tense atmosphere fills the room—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Splendid!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The courage to step forward when called on first!
The strength of heart to admit your faults right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A perfect score! You get a gold star!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And, Teacher!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Such care and proactive action for the students' safety!
Splendid! Full marks across the board!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you can find everyone's good points
and praise them, you get an extra gold star!
Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Right is clear! Left is clear! No Umamusume in sight!!
It's safe now!! You're clear to run!!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Th-Thank you so much!!
Um, I'll be on my way now...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
“—Look right, look left... and go run!
—Big sis is watching, so nothing to be afraid of, nothing at all.
—Slow down before the corner...”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone has relaxed!
As expected of me!! I'm so brilliant it's scary!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah...
Bakushin O's words completely changed the atmosphere...!
choice_data_list: It cleared up all at once, huh.
It cleared up all at once, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup~!
Man~ she's amazing~, so straightforward~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why your words reach straight into everyone's hearts, I'm sure!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"With today's lesson, you'll be safe and sound for life!!
My goodness, to think I'd even protect everyone's future!
As expected of me! As expected of the class representative!!!"
choice_data_list: You really did great out there, let's have a little celebration party!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! In that case, let's go eat sakura mochi!
I'll take you to my absolute favorite Japanese sweets shop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sakuramochi sounds awesome! They're in season right now!
Let's follow traffic rules and go full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Green light confirmed! Looking right, looking left...
Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"With today's lesson, you'll be safe and sound for life!!
My goodness, to think I'd even protect everyone's future!
As expected of me! As expected of the class representative!!!"
choice_data_list: You really did great out there, let's have a little celebration party!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! In that case, let's go eat sakura mochi!
I'll take you to my absolute favorite Japanese sweets shop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sakuramochi sounds awesome! They're in season right now!
Let's follow traffic rules and go full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The light is red! It cannot be helped!
Let us wait!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"With today's lesson, you'll be safe and sound for life!!
My goodness, to think I'd even protect everyone's future!
As expected of me! As expected of the class representative!!!"
choice_data_list: I learned a lot as a trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HOOOOO!!!! Have I even imparted
wisdom unto you, Trainer-san?!
I truly am far too exemplary, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's obey all traffic rules like super model students!
And head back to the dorm!!
Even though it's right over there!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushiiiiiiiiin!!!!
